---
title: "GitHub Repository Checklist"
---

> Use when setting up any new project repo under the RIPLRT org.

**Repo name:** _______________  **Project lead:** _______________  **Date:** _______________

## Setup
- [ ] Created under the RIPLRT GitHub organization
- [ ] Private by default (public only with PI approval)
- [ ] `README.md` describing the project + how to run it
- [ ] `.gitignore` excludes `data/`, secrets, large/binary files
- [ ] License decided (or "all rights reserved" if restricted)
- [ ] Standard structure: `data/ R|src/ analysis/ outputs/ docs/`

## Reproducibility
- [ ] Environment pinned (`renv.lock` or `requirements.txt`/`environment.yml`)
- [ ] Raw data treated as read-only; cleaning is scripted
- [ ] Relative paths only

## Collaboration
- [ ] Branch protection on `main` (PRs + review)
- [ ] Issues enabled; project board linked
- [ ] Collaborators added at least privilege
- [ ] Commit message conventions noted in README

## Governance
- [ ] No restricted/identifiable data committed — ever
- [ ] No credentials/tokens in history
- [ ] Required data-attribution text noted in README
